headline: European Defense Stocks Heading for First Annual Loss Since Pandemic
summary: Shares in European defense companies are on track for their first negative annual return since the pandemic. Earnings growth slowed under supply bottlenecks and delayed government project rollouts.
why: European defense contractors experienced significant equity rallies following increased military spending; earnings execution constraints directly impact valuation multiples.

impacts.name: European Defense Sector
impacts.why: Capacity constraints and project delays led to earnings momentum deceleration.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Slower-than-expected corporate profit growth led to sector-wide de-rating.
